title.quote: Learning to Optimize with Recurrent Hierarchical Transformers
title.value: Learning to Optimize with Recurrent Hierarchical Transformers

extractions.description: The paper contributes and empirically evaluates a recurrent hierarchical transformer learned optimizer, comparing it with learned and hand-designed optimizers on Fashion MNIST and CIFAR-10 and measuring runtime scaling.

type.quote: We show that our optimizer converges faster than strong baselines at a comparable memory overhead
type.justification: The work trains models and reports comparative loss and runtime experiments.

name.justification: The paper contributes a new learned optimizer.

name.justification: The optimizer is trained through meta-training, advancing a meta-learning application.

name.quote: first application of transformers in the learned optimization domain for neural network tasks
name.justification: The contribution concerns optimization of neural networks.

name.quote: We test our optimizer on two image recognition tasks
name.justification: Image recognition supplies the experimental setting rather than the main methodological contribution.
